question: Which of the following was widely considered as the ‘heaven born service’ for Indians during British rule?

options.text: Military service on the Burma front
The Indian Civil Service or ICS

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Indian Civil Service or ICS**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Civil Service (ICS) was widely considered the **'heaven-born service' for Indians**.
 
• Initially only Europeans were allowed but **later Indians were allowed **to join.
 
• They served in various capacities, including **district commissioners, tax collectors, and judges**.
 
• The present day Civil services (IAS,IPS, etc.) is legacy of ICS exam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• After independence in 1947, the ICS was renamed the **Indian Administrative Service (IAS)**.
 
• It is responsible for the **policies implementation, maintaining law and order, projects** at various levels of governance (central, state, and district).
 
• Other important civil services are Indian Foreign Service (IFS), Indian Police Service (IPS),Indian Revenue Service (IRS) and others.
